crew.overview: Two lost souls visiting Tokyo -- the young, neglected wife of a photographer and a washed-up movie star shooting a TV commercial -- find an odd solace and pensive freedom to be real in each other's company, away from their lives in America.
crew.title: Lost in Translation

details.biography: Japanese film director. Although he has worked with other directors, he is closely associated with the late film director Yoshimitsu Morita. He worked on 16 of Morita's films, beginning with "Something Like It" in 1981.  In 2016, he made his feature film directorial debut with "Something Like, Something Like It".
details.name: Taiichi Sugiyama
